page.notes: Much of the index is faded or blotted; the text is largely illegible. Only the most legible words and page numbers are given, and many entries are summarised with "..." in the transcription where the letters cannot be read reliably. Lines near the bottom of the left column are cut off by the scan edge. Lines are partly illegible in the scan; the entries shown are only the readable parts, and the sign s marks words I could not read. Several lines in the lower half are too faint to transcribe reliably. Most of this part is faded or obscured; the entries at the far left and in the middle are only partly legible and are given as far as they can be read. The right-hand column of the upper block continues the index of Hebrew and Greek words (Sabbath, Scarabaeus, Sceptrum, Schadad, Scepter, etc.), printed in small type with page numbers such as "9 b", "15", "21 b", "102". Those entries are index lines, not running text; the scan is too degraded to copy every letter reliably, so they are not fully transcribed here.
